# NORRAG Education

> NORRAG is a global education research network affiliated with The Graduate Institute in Geneva, advancing sustainable development through evidence-based education policy and practice.

NORRAG (Network for International Policies and Cooperation in Education and Training) serves as a hub for education research, policy dialogue, and knowledge exchange aligned with the UN's Sustainable Development Goals. The organization focuses on critical issues including adult education, early childhood development, AI in education, and decolonizing data practices across diverse global contexts.
